title: Heads or tails
goal: The button flips a coin: the app shows “Heads” or “Tails” at random.
stars: A random number when you tap.
An “if” block that chooses from that number.
The text shows “Heads” in one case and “Tails” in the other.
hint: With “random integer from 1 to 2”: 1 for Heads, 2 for Tails. The “if… else” block is in Control.
